subtitle: Lesson 31 · Update Sets & Change Management (Admin View)

steps.label: 1. Export
steps.sub: save the Completed Update Set as an XML file on the source instance

steps.label: 2. Retrieve
steps.sub: upload that XML onto the target instance -- creates a not-yet-applied record

steps.label: 3. Preview
steps.sub: compare every change against the target's current state before applying anything

steps.label: 4. Commit
steps.sub: actually apply the changes to the target instance

code:
For every captured change, Preview compares:
  version IN the Update Set
    vs.
  version currently ON the target instance

Flags potential COLLISIONS before anything
is applied -- not after.  (Lesson 32: detail)
caption: Preview is a safety gate, not a formality to click past.

code:
Dev  ->  Test/QA  ->  Production
  (always this order, Test never skipped)

Skip Test straight to Prod:
  = the "silent copy" risk course 2 warned about
  = Test's whole purpose defeated
caption: Test exists to catch what Preview flags, where a mistake costs nothing.

code:
Traditional: export / retrieve / preview / commit
  (still common, the foundation everything else
   automates)

Also used today:
  - Update Set batches (coordinated promotion)
  - Source Control / DevOps integration
    (config as code, promoted via pipelines)

Deep DevOps coverage: later course in this path
caption: Same underlying idea -- deliberate, reviewable promotion -- different tooling.
